cases.name: One BaseWindow and exactly one WebContentsView at startup; second view is gated
Native sandboxed renderer has no require/process or Node integration
Two distinct webContents share the same persistent session inside one native window
Both renderers accept browser-level trusted input, retain separate state and run timers concurrently
Independent native bounds follow resizing and a saved split ratio without gaps
Out-of-scope navigation, redirects and popups are denied without opening another window
Closing a secondary view destroys it and keeps the first original webContents alive
Closing BaseWindow destroys all owned webContents
Own synthetic HttpOnly session cookie persists across a real Electron restart
Closing BaseWindow destroys all owned webContents
